document.name: Sunset Daycare Sunset Park Enrichment
document.shortDescription: Daily enrichment classes and after-school tutoring in Sunset Park for children ages 6 weeks to 5 years.
document.longDescription:
Sunset Daycare's official Sunset Park pages describe two facilities across two floors at 338 42th Street in Brooklyn and say the location serves children from 6 weeks to 5 years old. The official program page says the site provides after-school tutoring and runs daily enrichment classes including Spanish, Literature, Science, Music, Art, and Yoga.

The same official Sunset Park location materials publish contact details of phone (929) 899-5284 and email sunsetdaycarenyc@gmail.com. Official hours for the Sunset Park location are 6 AM to 7 PM Monday to Friday and 8 AM to 5 PM on Saturday, which supports weekday, weekend, morning, after-school, and evening coverage for the published enrichment program.

Sources: https://www.sunsetdaycarenyc.com/sunset-park-daycare https://www.sunsetdaycarenyc.com/program https://www.sunsetdaycarenyc.com/ https://static1.squarespace.com/static/6669b11a09444264f72833ee/t/66c4f9b1fc68982276d11df3/1724185009111/Sunsetdaycare_social+share.png?format=1500w
